Scheduled quizzes stay on screen until answered, plus each morning.\n\nGreen means ready. Tap any missing item to open Settings (one at a time), then Arm. Usage access is needed so unlock can return to the last app.
Green means ready. Tap a missing item to fix it — status refreshes when you return.
Needed for QuizGate to work fully
Lets quizzes fire close to the schedule you chose. Without this, Android may delay or skip the schedule.
Allow exact alarms so quizzes fire on time
App notifications must stay on, and the Unlock quiz channel must stay at High importance — otherwise the alarm cue never shows.
Enable notifications (and High importance for Unlock quiz)
Keeps the schedule alive when the tablet sleeps. On Samsung, also keep QuizGate out of Sleeping / Deep sleeping apps.
Set battery to Unrestricted so alarms keep working
Helps the quiz open over the lock screen like an alarm. Still needs Appear on top when another app is open.
Allow full-screen alerts for the quiz
Helps the quiz open over games or videos when Android blocks background starts. Recommended for reliable open; Accessibility keeps the quiz confined after it appears.
Allow Appear on top — without it quizzes may not open over other apps
Required. Turns on QuizGate\'s quiz-confine service only during an active lock — not a screen reader, not full-device monitoring. If the child leaves the quiz, QuizGate brings it back until unlock.
Turn on QuizGate under Accessibility — needed for the lock
After unlock, returns your child to the app they were using. Quizzes still open without this.
Turn on Usage access to return to the last app

QuizGate lock: while a quiz lock is active, keeps the quiz on screen if the child switches away. Also notices screen off/on so the schedule does not wake a sleeping tablet and a lock quiz can appear on wake. Used only while Armed / during an active lock. Not a screen reader. Does not read passwords, messages, or other apps\' content. Parents can end a lock from the quiz (long-press the question) or Setup. Widget and Setup practice quizzes are unlocked and do not use this confine.
Optional. Long-press home → Widgets → QuizGate → Today\'s score — or tap Add below.

A few settings are still off

These improve lock-screen open and return-to-app, but scheduling can still run:

%1$s

Fix them now, or continue and change them later.
Turns on AI sync to api.quizgate.app. Optional parent email unlocks human admin at admin.quizgate.app (UUID + email + 2FA). Email is stored only as a hash.
Starts the question near the top. Kids can drag it anywhere; it snaps back if pulled too far off-screen.
Starts the question near the bottom. Kids can drag it anywhere; it snaps back if pulled too far off-screen.

Where should the question start?

• Top — recommended. Starts near the top of the screen.
• Bottom — starts near the bottom instead.

Kids can drag the question anywhere to clear a video or sticky finger. It snaps back if it goes too far. Change this later under Parents.
QuizGate picks Performance or Slim from battery, power saver, and device capability. Switches back when power is healthy. Default for most tablets.
Full quiz polish always: return-to-app, animations, and richer on-device diagnostics. Never auto-downgrades.
Full quiz polish always: return-to-app, animations, and richer on-device diagnostics. Never auto-downgrades.
Always lean: saves battery and CPU. Keeps quizzes on schedule. Turns off return-to-app, party animations, mid-quiz widget refresh, and extra diagnostic detail.

How should QuizGate use this tablet?

• Auto — recommended. Uses full features when the tablet is healthy; switches to Slim if battery is low, power saver is on, or the device is limited.
• Performance — always full features.
• Slim — always lean for battery and older tablets.

You can change this later under Parents.

When a scheduled quiz opens, it stays on screen until your child answers (or you open Parents).

Accessibility keeps the quiz on top if they tap Home or switch apps. You will turn on QuizGate under Accessibility next.

Practice from the home-screen score widget or Parents is unlocked — Home leaves freely.

Correct answers earn screen time.
Forever free — no ads, no purchases.

A closed-loop SI curates curricula; you keep every final decision.
Use photos from this tablet as quiz backdrops, or kid-friendly defaults (ocean, space, planes, nature, animals). You can skip and change later.

How often should QuizGate ask a question?
Default is about every half hour, with up to 15 minutes of randomness — so it can fire anywhere from 15 minutes to 45 minutes.

Next we'll turn on a few tablet settings, one at a time, so quizzes open on time and return to the last app.
Without this setting, scheduled quizzes often never appear. You can fix it on the next screen before Arming.
Required. Android needs Exact alarms so QuizGate can ask a question close to the schedule you chose — not only when the tablet happens to wake up.
Required. Keep notifications on for QuizGate, and leave the Unlock quiz channel at High importance. If notifications are off, the quiz cue never shows.
Required. Set QuizGate to Unrestricted battery so the schedule keeps working when the tablet sleeps. On Samsung tablets, also make sure QuizGate is not in Sleeping or Deep sleeping apps.
Full-screen alerts help the quiz open over the lock screen like an alarm. When another app is already open, Appear on top is still required.
Required. This is the setting that failed most often in testing: without Appear on top, the tablet may fire the schedule but the quiz never opens over games or videos. Turn it on for QuizGate.
Usage access lets QuizGate remember which app your child was using. After a correct answer, it can return them there automatically. Quizzes still open without this.

Required. In Accessibility settings, turn on QuizGate. This only confines the quiz while a scheduled lock is active — it is not a screen reader and does not monitor the whole device. If your child leaves the quiz, QuizGate brings it back until they unlock or a parent opens Setup.
All critical tablet settings look good. On the next screen, tap Arm scheduling. After that, opening QuizGate starts a practice question — parents stay available from the success screen.
